## Connection

Participants were deeply connected to queer and trans communities (see @tbl-connection). About two-thirds had 1–10 queer or trans friends in the past month; 20 percent had none. Half reported 1–3 recent sexual partners, one-fifth four or more. About a third traveled 16–30 minutes for a hookup, another third more than 30. Nearly one in four had non-sexual physical contact with two or more people at once, and a third had no physical contact. 

Overall, 40 percent reported sex or physical contact with multiple people at the same time, forming the core network structure analyzed in later sections.
